_note: Ukrainian; see topbar.json and docs/translating.md. The Settings window as home/settings.rs draws it: the list's four groups (their names set in capitals), each page's name and what its row says (a readout with a .short form when the row is narrow), the Set Up button, the pages (Screens, Slides, Groups, Language, Keys, Command line, Song files, About). The Groups page is about a song's parts, so it is Частини пісень. On and Off are Увімк. and Вимк., as in the top bar.
